Subject: Your next trail starts with the right sock
Preview: Three pairs of merino blend. Ready when the miles are.
Body: You already know the difference a good sock makes — blisters on mile two versus feeling solid at mile twelve.

The Northbay Trailwool Sock (NB-SOK-11) is built for everyday trail use. It's a merino wool blend, which means it regulates temperature, manages moisture, and handles the kind of repeated wear that happens when you're out more weekends than not.

The pack comes with three pairs, so you're stocked for a full trip or a full week without doing laundry mid-adventure.

A note on fit: these are everyday trail socks. They're not engineered for technical mountaineering or extreme cold. If you're doing high-alpine winter routes, you'll want something purpose-built for that. For day hikes, backpacking trips, and regular trail time — this is the sock you'll reach for.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
